games.title: Server Kart
games.description: Everybody drives Mike. Race the group chat, drift through the nonsense, and try not to pay the cheese tax.

games.title: Don't Spill the Soup
games.description: One full bowl. A short walk. A very unhelpful cat. Get as much soup to the table as you can.

games.title: One More Person
games.description: Everyone insists they can fit. Pack the passengers, mind the doorway, and see if the doors will close.

games.title: The Fold
games.description: Walk into a folded-up library. Fight with cards. Merge two spells into something stronger.
